# Agent Website Blueprint

> Documentation and automation blueprint, not a prebuilt website. Start with the operating contract and master prompt. Recheck current official instructions before implementation.

## Entry points
- [README](README.md): Beginner workflow and repository map.
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): State/evidence/approval/security rules.
- [Start here](prompts/START-HERE.md): Prompt selection.
- [Master builder](prompts/website-builder.md): Discovery through maintenance.
- [Resume](prompts/resume-project.md): Continue from actual Git/project state.

## Current authoritative information
- [Freshness protocol](docs/source-freshness.md): Match installed versions, inspect changes/advisories, verify instructions.
- [Source register](docs/sources.md): Official tool/framework/security/pricing navigation.
- [Machine-readable sources](docs/sources.json): Topic IDs, URLs, indexes, changelogs, review/execution status.
- [External retrieval evidence](docs/external-link-checks.json): Reachability only, not content review.

## Implementation and evidence
- [Guide index](docs/README.md): Twenty-five guides in order; choose required modules.
- [Planning](planning/README.md): Persistent .project/ templates and ADR.
- [Security baseline](security/security-baseline.md): Applicable control/evidence matrix.
- [Recipes](examples/README.md): Six architectural examples, not tested applications.
- [Integrations](docs/integrations.md): Optional need/cost/alternative matrix.
- [Templates](templates/README.md): Config, contracts, read-only SQL and headers.
- [Automation](automation/README.md): Opt-in bounded daily/weekly checks and monthly human review.
- [Validation](docs/validation-report.md): Executed checks and limits.

## Operational release details
- [Failure modes](docs/25-operational-failure-modes.md): Configuration lifecycle, recoverable fulfillment, protected files, Access identity and honest evidence.
- [Environment matrix](planning/environment-matrix-template.md): Intended parity and configuration ownership, without secret values.
- [Release evidence](planning/release-evidence-template.md): Exact preview/version and failure-case verification.

## Repository use and maintenance
- [Worked local example](examples/worked-static-site/README.md): Fictional requirements through reproducible local HTTP evidence and handoff; no hosted site.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): Current work and verification gaps.
- [Release policy](docs/releases.md): Versioning, compatibility and evidence boundaries.
